title: Quietly baked Egyptian lentil Bake
description: A creamy and comforting Egyptian dish featuring fermented lentils and a hint of rum, perfect for a sick day, this vegan-friendly recipe is baked on a cedar plank to add a unique flavor, the fermentation process gives this dish a rich and tangy taste.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the fermented lentils, chopped onion, minced garlic, rum, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and nutritional yeast, and mix well.
Place the mixture on the soaked cedar plank, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the top of the lentil mixture.
Bake the lentil mixture for 35 minutes, or until it is lightly browned and set.
Remove the cedar plank from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the quietly baked Egyptian lentil bake hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
